Sitr guard has two uses. Child lock: while a guardian has the lock on, it closes the screens that would switch Sitr off: its app info and other settings pages that show Sitr\'s name, uninstalling, its VPN and accessibility settings, the VPN disconnect dialog, Developer options, adding users, setting up or opening a private space, Second space and Dual apps (Xiaomi), the Private DNS dialog and the mobile network reset. Reels blocking: while you have it on in Sitr, it reads the Facebook app\'s screen and leaves the Reels tab or a reel opened full screen. Screen text is read on this phone only and thrown away at once; nothing is stored or sent anywhere. Sitr does not filter a private space, work profile or other user.
